dedicated.story:
"The honorable knight has lost his light, and his noble loyalty has forsaken its glory."

A knight of honor, once devoted to the service of the Knight of Light, was resurrected by demonic powers after his death to aid in an act of vengeance — but after being resurrected once more, he forgot all his former vows and glory and succumbed to corruption. The sword he once wielded in the name of the Light crumbled, and his honorable loyalty was defiled by darkness, leading him to a tragic end in which both light and glory were lost.

lore:
Knox wandered aimlessly. He did not even know where he was. The landscape shifted — one moment it felt like a desolate desert, the next like a damp swamp, and then suddenly a rain-soaked forest. He could not recall why he was walking. His legs felt heavy and sluggish as though they were sunk in mud, yet he pressed on without rest.

But with every step he took, something precious slipped away. One person's face faded away. Another's name. Someone else's voice. Such was the price of defying the natural order.

Then, a voice echoed through his mind. Amidst the uncertainty and unease, that warm, benevolent voice rang clear.
"Your time has come to an end. You may stop now, and rest."
Knox came to a halt. That was right. He was one of the dead. No one knew that better than Knox himself. Yet, what was it that had driven him —once an honorable knight— to rise again, defying death itself? Surely, there had to be a reason.
"A name... that name..."
There was someone he had to remember. But it remained elusive, as if his thoughts were shrouded in a thick fog. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't remember.
"It is time for you to depart."
But Knox forced himself back on his feet. And began walking again.

"Stop. If you go any further, you will never know eternal rest."
The voice was no longer gentle or benevolent. It had become so cold and chilling that even Knox, an undead, felt himself frozen with fear. But it was precisely that return of emotion —of fear— that allowed him to remember what he once could not.
"...Kris."
"What?"
At that moment, Knox's sword and shield began to glow.
"That is the name of the one I serve. The name of my liege... and the reason I have returned from death!"
The instant Kris's name crossed his mind, a new power surged through Knox's body.
"My loyalty has not yet come to an end!"
